title: The high plateau and Lake Titicaca: a lake that keeps the frost away
goal: Describe the Bolivian high plateau and Lake Titicaca, using relative clauses with que and quien.
grammar: relative clauses with que and quien

items: I can describe the high plateau and Lake Titicaca with relative clauses introduced by *que* and *quien*.
I can say why families by the lake can grow crops at that altitude.
I can name what totora, bofedales and llamas are in Spanish.
